title: Command
description: Canonical command envelope sent from the SCADA/application layer to a bridge device. The ESP32 bridge firmware reads command_id (integer) or request_id (string) for correlation, and command_name for the operation token.

command_id.description: Integer correlation ID. Preferred when the caller uses a numeric counter. The bridge converts this to a string for deduplication and ACK correlation. Mutually exclusive with request_id; if both are present, command_id takes precedence.

request_id.description: String correlation ID. Accepted for UUID-based or legacy callers. When command_id is also present, command_id takes precedence.

correlation_id.description: Optional external correlation id (e.g. UUID) for end-to-end tracing between the SCADA layer and the bridge log. Not used by the bridge firmware.

device_id.description: Target device/bridge identifier. Accepted but not validated by the bridge firmware. The bridge routes to the correct device via the MQTT topic.

command_name.description: Name of the command to execute on the device.

arguments.description: Positional arguments passed to the command. Max 2 are processed (channel + value for SET_OUTPUT; speed for CONVEYOR_START).

items.description: Printable ASCII, 1-64 bytes. Must not contain: comma, asterisk, at-sign, CR or LF.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the command was issued. Accepted but not used by the bridge firmware.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds before the command is considered stale. The ESP32 bridge firmware uses a fixed retry budget (3 attempts, 1 s interval). TTL enforcement via wall-clock deadline is planned.
